title: Concept: TLS verification override configured (csharp) — review required
description: In csharp, ServerCertificateCustomValidationCallback.{0,40}=>s*true disables a TLS authenticity check. Without verification, encryption still runs but against whoever answers — including an attacker. The remedy is restoring verification (chain validation).
applicability: csharp TLS clients and configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Machine-in-the-middle interception of all traffic on the connection; HIGH severity.
